_comment: Implicit dependency edges that BuildRequires cannot express. when_spec_uses_macro: add an edge to every package in `requires` for specs whose raw text uses the named macro. Used by generate-build-order.py so a tier never needs a package from its own tier.

implicit_deps.why: %cmake_build_kf6 runs the qdoc targets (prepare_docs/generate_docs), which need qdoc from qt6-qttools at build time. sonic-rpm-macros pulls it in via Requires: cmake(Qt6ToolsTools), so every spec using the macro needs qt6-qttools in an EARLIER tier.
